fine_tuning_verdict: EXTREME fine-tuning (off by orders of magnitude)
interpretation: Phase 48 tests whether the T90.70 4-resonance structure can emerge naturally from a concrete hidden-valley benchmark (dark SU(N_c) with N_f flavors). Best case: N_c=2, N_f=2, Lambda_dark=50 MeV, m_chi=10000 MeV produces resonances at 30000-78000 km/s, but T90.70 requires 28-700 km/s. Fine-tuning measure: 2.61 orders of magnitude off.
